title: Paralegal - Family
company: Capital Outsourcing Group Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Family Care Paralegal

Make a difference. Build your career. Be part of a team that cares.

Are you a Paralegal looking to build your career in Family Law? Do you want a role where your work has a genuine impact on people's lives?

We're looking for a Family Care Paralegal to join a busy, supportive and dedicated Family Team.

This is a fantastic opportunity to develop your experience in Family Care and public law children matters, working alongside experienced Solicitors and Legal Advisers on a varied caseload including care proceedings and pre-proceedings work.

You'll play an important role in supporting clients through what can often be some of the most challenging and sensitive periods of their lives. Alongside gaining valuable legal experience, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, develop your technical skills and grow your career within a specialist area of law.

What's in it for you?

We believe that great people deserve great benefits. In return for your hard work and commitment, you'll enjoy:
- Hybrid and flexible working - giving you greater choice over how you work.
- 25 days' annual leave + bank holidays
- Your birthday off - because everyone deserves a day to celebrate.
- Death in Service scheme
- Healthcare cash plan
- A supportive team environment where your development and progression are encouraged.
- The opportunity to gain valuable hands-on experience in a specialist area of Family Law.

What will you be doing?

No two days will be exactly the same. You'll work closely with Solicitors and Legal Advisers, helping to keep cases moving and ensuring clients receive the high standard of service they deserve.

Your role will include:
- Supporting Solicitors and Legal Advisers with Family Care matters, including care proceedings and pre-proceedings work.
- Providing professional, empathetic and client-focused support to clients facing sensitive and challenging circumstances.
- Drafting correspondence, legal documents, witness statements, chronologies and applications.
- Liaising with clients, Courts, Local Authorities, Counsel, CAFCASS, experts and other third parties.
- Attending Court and client meetings where appropriate.
- Maintaining accurate and well-organised client files and case records.
- Monitoring deadlines and supporting the progression of cases.
- Preparing Court bundles, hearing papers, briefing packs and other documentation.
- Assisting with Legal Aid applications and administration.
- Supporting client due diligence, AML and data protection requirements.
- Assisting with billing, time recording, disbursements and other administrative tasks.
- Working collaboratively with colleagues and supporting the wider team during busy periods.
- Keeping your knowledge up to date with relevant legal developments and procedural changes.

Most importantly, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of delegated work, build your confidence and develop your career as your experience grows.

What are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who is organised, driven and genuinely passionate about delivering excellent client service.

You'll ideally have:
- A relevant legal qualification, such as a Law Degree, LPC, SQE or CILEX qualification, or relevant practical experience.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- A keen eye for detail and a commitment to accuracy.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- A professional, approachable and compassionate manner.
- The ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and integrity.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and case management systems.
- The confidence to work independently while also being a strong team player.

If you're looking for a role where you can develop your legal career, gain valuable experience and make a real difference to clients, we'd love to hear from you.

Office hours: Monday to Friday, 9am - 5pm

title: Credit Controller
description:
Role Overview
As Credit Controller you will play an important role within the credit control department in meeting cash flow requirements with a strong emphasis on building and maintaining client relationships ensuring service standards are of the highest level.

Essential Duties:
- Opening new accounts and responsible for the day-to-day management of your customer base.
- Establish and maintain internal and external customer relationships at all levels in a calm and professional manner.
- Ensure as necessary all calls, letters, statements and follow up actions are carried out in order to bring the matter to the customer's attention to obtain payment of due/overdue depts.

- Have a flexible approach to an ever-changing workload with the ability to prioritise.
- These duties are not exhaustive and may vary from time to time, depending on the needs of the business.

Skills & Qualifications:
- Minimum of 3 years' experience working in a credit control/cash collection role and ideally in a sales driven environment. MICM preferred but not essential.
- Competent with Microsoft Office products especially Excel and experience of using finance systems (IBCOS).
- Have an excellent telephone manner.
- Team player with proactive positive attitude and strong organisational skills.
- A systematic approach and an eye for detail.
- Ability to influence, negotiate and make judgements on need for consultation and escalation.

title: Credit Controller
description:

title: Administration assistant
description: Posterngate surgery are recruiting an efficient administration assistant to join our small team of data administrators who maintain our patient medical records with relevant clinical information with accuracy and in a timely manner to inform patient care. (Previous applicants need not apply) The data administration team contribute in maintaining accurate medical records, which includes summarising and read coding relevant information on to patients records from hospital correspondence and other sources into the practice computer system, working strictly in accordance with the practice protocols. The main responsibilities of the post-holder will be to scan documents, summarise and read code relevant information from the patients clinical records, hospital correspondence and other sources into the patients electronic SystmOne record held on the Practice Computer. Working strictly in accordance with the Practice notes summarising and read code protocols. Key Tasks Translate clinical information into appropriate read codes, forwarding letters onto GPs for checking. Summarise records and produce an accurate summary of patient medical history. Record incoming & outgoing medical records onto SystmOne from Primary Care Support England. Liaise with Primary Care Support England with any queries relating to patient records and protocols. Extraction of necessary data from clinical correspondence and input into electronic patient record. View and disseminate hospital correspondence to GPs, ensuring that any urgent actions are flagged with appropriate member of staff. Process links for pathology, radiology and microbiology results. Maintain efficient system to file historical paper medical records. Scan copies of relevant electronic and paper patient communications using SystmOne into patient records. Undertake GP2GP transactions for transfer of patient medical records. Locate and retrieve documents as needed by clinical and non-clinical staff. Prepare monthly audit reports for clinicians when requested. Process tasks, emails and general queries. Deal with patient queries.

Workflow within the clinical system Supporting recall systems Handling patient queries where appropriate Provide administrative support to cover for colleagues; scan, file, and accurately attach incoming documents to patient records, medical reports, scanning of documents, opening post. Answering incoming calls, transferring calls, responding to patients. Organising, implementing and liaising with patients for Patient Participation Group Meetings. Support all staff with queries and general administrative tasks. To have knowledge of all practice procedures and to work in accordance to written protocols To provide administrative support and cover duties for other members of staff if required Welcoming patients upon arrival at the front desk of the surgery Making appointments for patients via telephone or face to face Handling queries from patients and diverting them to the right department Handing completed repeat prescriptions to patients and checking names and address Dealing with doctors visit requests and printing the relevant information for the doctor Maintaining the reception area to a professional standard

title: Data Administrator
description: We are looking for a highly organised and reliable part-time Data Administrator to join our team for 20.5 hours per week. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a busy environment, has excellent attention to detail and takes pride in providing a high standard of administrative support. You will work alongside existing staff to provide a sensitive, efficient and confidential service to patients Offer general assistance to the practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone Assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way Undertake a variety of administrative duties to assist in the smooth running of the practice Facilitate effective communication between patients, members the primary health care team, secondary care and other associated healthcare agencies Duties may be varied from time to time under the direction of the Practice Manager, dependent on current and evolving practice workload and staffing levels: Using the Practice Welby Innovate system to file pathology results, run reports, send text messages/letters to ensure patient compliance with Annual Treatment review process Dealing with safeguarding documentation Monitoring the Practice communication system "AccuRx" Helping the Practice achieve maximum QoF points by running Welby reports and making sure patients attend for review within the given time frame Monitoring the Practice generic e-mail and responding to queries Scanning paperwork received by the practice and adding to an appropriate workflow batch on SystmOne. Responding to any tasks sent in the clinical system Helping the GP liaise with outside agencies e.g. getting an on call doctor on the phone to ask advice or arrange admission while the GP can continue with their consultations Liaising with the Medical Examiner service and Coroner to ensure appropriate paperwork is processed and forwarded to them Checking the online Manage Patient Registrations Portal (MPR) and processing new patient registrations and adding appropriate codes to the clinical record. Contacting patients and running through Welby questionnaires to support those patients who are unable to reply via text message. Job Summary The purpose of the role is to Work alongside existing staff to provide a sensitive, efficient and confidential service to patients Duties and Responsibilities Duties may be varied from time to time under the direction of the Practice Manager, dependent on current and evolving practice workload and staffing levels Scanning paperwork received by the practice and adding to an appropriate workflow batch on SystmOne Checking the online Manage Patient Registrations Portal (MPR) and processing new patient registrations and adding appropriate codes to the clinical record Any other duties which may be appropriate for the role of Data Administrator Confidentiality In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters. They do so in confidence and have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy and act appropriately In the performance of the duties outlined in this Job Description, the post-holder may have access to confidential information relating to patients and their carers, practice staff and other healthcare workers. They may also have access to information relating to the practice as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data Health & Safety The post-holder will implement and lead on a full range of promotion and management their own and others health and safety and infection control as defined in the practice Health & Safety Policy and the practice Infection Control policy and published procedures. This will include (but will not be limited to) Using personal security systems within the workplace according to practice guidelines Identifying the risks involved in work activities and undertaking such activities in a way that manages those risks Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills Using appropriate infection control procedures, maintaining work areas in a tidy and safe way and free from hazards Actively reporting of health and safety hazards and infection hazards immediately when recognised Responsible for correct hand hygiene Keeping own work areas and general / patient areas generally clean, assisting in the maintenance of general standards of cleanliness consistent with the scope of the job holder's role Undertaking periodic infection control training Equality and Diversity The post-holder will support the equality, diversity and rights of patients, carers and colleagues, to include Acting in a way that recognizes the importance of peoples rights, interpreting them in a way that is consistent with practice procedures and policies, and current legislation Respecting the privacy, dignity, needs and beliefs of patients, carers and colleagues Behaving in a manner which is welcoming to and of the individual, is non-judgmental and respects their circumstances, feelings priorities and rights. Personal/Professional Development The post-holder will participate in any training programme implemented by the practice as part of this employment, such training to include Participation in an annual individual performance review, including taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work. Quality The post-holder will strive to maintain quality within the practice, and will Alert other team members to issues of quality and risk Assess own performance and take accountability for own actions, either directly or under supervision Contribute to the effectiveness of the team by reflecting on own and team activities and making suggestions on ways to improve and enhance the teams performance Work effectively with individuals in other agencies to meet patients' needs Effectively manage your own time, workload and resources. Communication The post-holder should recognise the importance of effective communication within the team and will strive to Communicate effectively with other team members Communicate effectively with patients and carers Recognise peoples needs for alternative methods of communication and respond accordingly. Contribution to the Implementation of Services The post-holder will Apply practice policies, standards and guidance Discuss with other members of the team how the policies, standards and guidelines will affect own work Participate in audit where appropriate Policy and Service Development Implementation Comply with practice policies and procedures as defined within the staff handbook and the practice policy library Responsibilities for Financial and Physical Resourses Undertake to manage the private fees process for patients, being aware of the procedure to follow Liaising with IT support services relevant to post and equipment used to instigate repair Responsibilities for Human Resources Assist with training new staff as required Provide annual leave / sickness cover as necessary Attend all mandatory training sessions and undertake any additional training required to fulfill the requirement of the role Freedom to Act Follow standard operating procedures and guidelines This job description contains the principal duties of the post and a range of other duties is implicit in these. The duties may be amended from time to time to reflect any changes in the needs of the service in discussion with the post holder. Safeguarding Children and Vulnerable Adults To ensure awareness and be alert to, the signs and symptoms of abuse in children through regular participation in mandatory and refresher child protection training To be familiar with all relevant Safeguarding Children and Young People, policies and procedures and contact points, taking the appropriate action when there is knowledge or suspicion of a child who has been subject to abuse To be familiar with all relevant Safeguarding Vulnerable Adults, policies and procedures and contact points, taking the appropriate action when there is knowledge or suspicion of a vulnerable adult who has been subject to abuse Community Infection Prevention and Control In order to comply with the Health and Social Care Act 2008: code of practice on the prevention and control of infection and related guidance, it is the responsibility of every member of staff to prevent and control the spread of infection and to follow the organisation's Infection Prevention and Control Policies. They will also ensure that they perform the correct hand hygiene procedures as described in the Hand Hygiene Policy All staff contribute to effective antimicrobial stewardship through prevention and timely diagnosis of infection, and use of antimicrobials All staff contribute to the standards of cleanliness and are aware of the person who has direct responsibility for ensuring the cleanliness standards are maintained

title: Patient Care Navigator (Medical Receptionist - Priory Medical Centre)
description: Patient Care Navigator Patient Care Navigator (PCN) - "What is that?" you ask You may know us as Doctor's Receptionists. However things have changed and contrary to what people may think we don't just say "take a seat" nor do we have the power to decide who gets an appointment and who doesn't. We play a vital role in assisting patients to access healthcare at PMG. From answering queries at the front desk, to helping patients with prescription requests, to communicating with other teams on behalf of our patients, as well as the day-to-day admin responsibilities we undertake; we are an essential part of primary care and help our PMG patients access the help they need. Here at PMG are looking for people with: Excellent communications and customer service skills, Attention to detail IT literate Ability to be discreet/ respect patient confidentiality Previous experience in a similar role is desirable but NOT essential We are looking for 23.25 hours per week with the below working pattern at Priory Medical Centre, YO24 3WX: Monday 7:45am to 1pm Tuesday 1pm to 6pm Wednesday 1pm to 8pm Thursday 1pm to 8pm Main Duties 1.Receiving patients appropriately, with a smile and with a warm demeanour, efficiently and accurately checking in patients arriving for appointments, making appointments both from in person discussions and via our electronic appointment request tool, issuing prescriptions, taking messages for medical staff or other information as required. 2.Answering telephone calls warmly whilst efficiently and appropriately, making appointments, taking and issuing prescription requests, relaying messages and visit requests to medical staff in the appropriate way. 3.Efficiently and accurately retrieving information, such as printouts and notes for medical staff, from within the surgery. 4.Efficiently and accurately obtain information as required by the doctor from other organisations, such as local hospitals. 5.Efficiently and accurately prepare any necessary forms for medical procedures, such as antenatal, blood testing, x-rays and cytology 6.Ensuring that all consulting rooms are ready for use, tidy and well stocked. 7.Efficiently and accurately secure the premises safely when surgery is closed. 8.To ensure any CQC requirements and/or documentation for which the post holder is responsible for is completed timely and accurately. To also ensure any procedures and processes applicable to the role are followed timely and accurately. 9.To ensure you devote the whole of your time, attention and abilities to your role, our business and its goals 10.Such other duties as may reasonably be delegated from time to time.
